meta.what: Method-and-round benchmark: per fight P(A/B by KO/TKO in round r), P(A/B by submission in round r), P(A/B by decision), P(draw); everything else (finish, method split, 7-bin, finishing round, P(fighter wins by KO/sub/dec)) is a marginal
meta.cells: fights[id][variant] = A KO r1..R, A SUB r1..R, B KO r1..R, B SUB r1..R, A DEC, B DEC, DRAW (R = scheduled rounds; A = first ufcstats name, as in backtest.json); KO/TKO includes doctor and corner stoppages; DQ and no-contests are not modelled

variants.S: stats only: pre-fight UFC stats, record, age, Elo; usable for any matchup at any time
variants.SM: S plus the closing moneyline (log-odds) as a feature and a separate winner logit; the line is known only minutes before the fight, so SM is a live/stacking variant
variants.*_refit: same hyperparameters, coefficients re-estimated each Jan 1 on everything before (2025 and 2026 fights only; 2024 equals the frozen fit)

meta.walk_forward: features use only fights before the fight date; priors from the 5 calendar years before the fight's year; hyperparameters and blend weight chosen by expanding-window CV with validation years 2020-2023; 2019-2023 predictions are out-of-fold (fit_through = Dec 31 of the previous year); 2024+ predictions come from the fit through 2023-12-31
meta.market_sources: data/derived/market.json (tools/market.py: consensus closing moneyline; method6, round and decision props from US books on BestFightOdds, 2021+); nlbair/ufc-data closing ranges (data/raw/odds/nlbair_odds.csv) for 2013-2018 moneylines

js_model.note: evaluate with tools/methodround_model.js (source embedded below); profiles are fighters.json entries; extras[slug] = [streak, last result code, finishing-win minutes, finishing wins, finished-loss minutes, finished losses, round-1 finishing wins, round-1 finished losses, career fight minutes (all bouts), bouts with a time, mean pre-fight opponent Elo]
